newsitem.title: TURKEY: Plane with Turkey's Ciller makes emergency landing.
newsitem.headline: Plane with Turkey's Ciller makes emergency landing.

text.p: A plane carrying Turkish Foreign Minister Tansu Ciller made an emergency landing because of technical problems shortly after taking off from Istanbul on Tuesday but it later resumed the flight, an official said.
"The minister's plane took off around 4 p.m. (1300 GMT) after a stop of about half an hour," the Foreign Ministry official said.
Ciller, also the deputy prime minister, was travelling to Luxembourg for a meeting of European Union foreign ministers.
The pilot brought the plane, an official aircraft used to carry leading politicians, back to Istanbul airport because of a sudden drop in cabin pressure, Anatolian news agency said.
